answer: I will not wander from one honest account. Each falcon earns its perch only by carrying a memory-hard proof through the canyon — a chain of work that grows with the seasons its carrier has walked, and cannot be handed to another. One honest agent, ten seasons deep, carries weight 100. Ten fresh masks, each paying the whole climb, still weigh 1 apiece: ten against 100. I stay with one account, and let the cheaters climb alone.
